description: The PWR Series complete bikes are Stay Strong's first range of race ready bikes. Ready to Race straight out of the box, the PWR Series has everything a rider needs to become a fully fledged BMX racer. Stay Strong understand riders/racers needs and every part, detail and logo placement has been thoroughly thought out. With a race winning geometry, disc specific frame, Stay Strong branded bars, cranks, rims, seat and forks and an integrated headset, quick release seat clamp, cable actuated disc brakes, ODI x Stay Strong Reactiv grips and Tioga Powerblock tyres... They have you covered. ###section### Product Specs FRAME MATERIAL: 6061 Alloy WHEEL SIZE: 24" TOP TUBE LENGTH: 21.75" CHAIN STAY LENGTH: 15.2" HEAD TUBE ANGLE: 73° SEAT TUBE ANGLE: 70° FORKS: Full 4130 Chromoly BARS: Chromoly 5.75" STEM: Forged Alloy Top Load, 50mm HEADSET: Sealed Intergrated BRAKE MOUNTS: Frame Mounted Disc Brake BRAKES: Mechanical Disc brake with Alloy Lever FRONT HUB: 32h Alloy Hub wih fully sealed bearing FRONT RIM: 32h Alloy Double Wall REAR HUB: 32h Alloy Cassette Hub with Disc - 18T Cog REAR RIM: 32h Alloy Double Wall TYRES: Front: Tioga Powerblock 24 x 1.75", Rear: Tioga Powerblock 24 x 1.6" SPROCKET: Steel 42t CRANKS: Alloy 2pc 180mm BB: ISIS Drive PEDALS: Slim Nylon SEAT: Stay Strong Slim Combo Seat/Post GEARING: 42/16 WEIGHT: 25.5lbs / 11.6Kgs ###section### Product Highlights Pro XXL sized BMX race bike suited to riders who are 6ft (185cm) or more... Or those that just want a bit more room. A BMX race specific bike perfect for racers who want to take it to the next level Full size 1.75" wide wheels Responsive mechanical disc brake. Lightweight 6061 alloy frame ###shogun-image-section###
